Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

Top international current affairs are covered by using eyewitness accounts from Observers- people who are at the heart of an event. They send their photos and videos, which are verified and contextualized by France 24 team of professional journalists in Paris. The Observers are volunteers, and are not paid for their contributions.

programme.desc: The Observers on France 24 is a weekly show produced with photos, videos and personal accounts from Observers around the world. Top international current affairs are covered by using eyewitness accounts from Observers- people who are at the heart of an event. The Observers are volunteers, and are not paid for their contributions.

programme.title: Heaven Can Help
programme.desc: Mak born unlucky, he is driven to despair after a series of depressing events and got himself into a car accident. As he passed out, his spirit went to hell where the devils told him that he will die after the deaths of the Millionaire Wong, Ms. Pao and Mr. Shek. Soon Mak came to his senses. At the same time, a big bag is thrown at him from a passing car. Inside it is the dead body of Millionaire Wong. Mak went to warn Pao only to find her murdered. Mak tried to convince Shek by telling him about the deaths of Millionaire Wong and Pao but Shek didn't believe him. In total desperation, Mak turned to Shek's sister for help. At midnight, Shek had a meeting...

programme.title: Bullet In The Head
programme.desc: In 1967, Hong Kong, Ben, Paul, and Frank are childhood friends and members of a gang. They regularly brawl with members of other gangs...

programme.title: Stolen Love
programme.desc: Young architect Rick treats love as a game. One day, while he was checking out the poster of writer Lok Ching-I's new book, he got hit by a car...

programme.title: City On Fire
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat plays Ko Chow, a police undercover agent who is torn between his duty as a police officer and his loyalty to his friends on the wrong side of the law.

programme.title: Aces Go Places V
programme.desc: White Glove steals terra-cotta warriors and Brother and Sister disguise themselves as the 'ACES' partners King Kong and Kodajak to steal the Sword of Chin Dynasty from White Glove. White Glove swears to revenge on the 'ACES' partners. The real and new 'ACES' partners will join together with police to fight against White Glove.

programme.title: Extraordinary Best Actors: Sea Wolves
programme.desc: As a Philippine freighter moors in Hong Kong, Gary, a man on board, assaults a Customs Officer during a routine inspection and escapes ashore. Then, a series of homicides occur near the pier. The killer's identity and motive remain a mystery until Inspector Yeung is assigned to investigate the case and links it to Gary. Acting on a tip-off that Gary is hiding in a prostitute's home, Yeung tries to trap him, but the polices also arrest the Captain's brother, John...

programme.title: Once upon a time in Triad Society
programme.desc: As the triad boss Lek-kuen is dying after being shot, he remembers how he became a triad member. Under the influence of Brethen Sheung-yee, Lek-kuen joined the triad society. Yet, Lek-kuen is so kind in nature that his superior and colleagues always betray him. He escapes to Japan but is still attacked by enemies, embroiling his wife Wooden Cart Noodle being killed. Afterwards, Lek-kuen becomes the worst guy among the triad members. At this moment, the story returns to the space-time when Lek-kuen is dying. In fact, he trumps up the mentioned story. The truth is that Lek-kuen does all kinds of evil but he survives from assassination. During the tussle between the Japanese triads and Hong Kong police, Lek-kuen is saved by a mysterious lady. Nevertheless, he is finally shot dead though nobody knows who the murderer is...

programme.title: E2 - Palau Shark Sanctuary
programme.desc: Palau is a tiny country with a big story. In 2009, this island nation in the middle of the western Pacific Ocean created the world’s first shark sanctuary to protect more than 100 shark species from reckless overfishing and the brutal practice of commercial shark finning. Then, in 2014, Palau once again led the way. It established the world’s largest marine sanctuary – a no-go zone for foreign commercial fisheries nearly the size of California.

programme.title: E1 - Island of the White Shark
programme.desc: Off Guadalupe Island, Mexico, top shark ecologist Mauricio Hoyos attempts a television first. Get a unique view as he attaches a camera to the dorsal fin of a great white, revealing how it swims, hunts, and ultimately strikes its prey.

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists following their every move. Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys – mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice. After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs. Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”. programme.title: E1
programme.desc: Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists following their every move. Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys – mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice. After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs. Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
